changeAlert.title: Permission Change Notice
changeAlert.description: Changes to permissions take effect only after you log in again (permissions are embedded in the JWT); the server-side cache expires after about 5 minutes.

roleDescriptions.OPERATOR: All read/write permissions, excluding system management, security management manage, and infrastructure
roleDescriptions.USER: Dashboard + configuration read-only + traffic governance + monitoring read-only + tracing search + AI playground

messages.loadRolesFailed: Failed to load role permissions, please try again
messages.saveSuccess: Permissions saved; changes take effect after you log in again
messages.saveFailed: Failed to save permissions, please try again
messages.resetApplied: Reset to the latest permissions saved on the server
